description: List the templates (prebuilt base images) your team can launch sandboxes from. Call this before sandbox_create to choose a from_template instead of guessing a name. Official templates are curated by Superserve, available to every team, and named with the reserved `superserve/` prefix — e.g. `superserve/python-3.11`, `superserve/node-22`, `superserve/openclaw`; names without that prefix are your team's own templates. Returns each template's name, status, and resources; only templates whose status is ready can be used.

name_prefix.description: Only return templates whose name starts with this prefix — e.g. 'superserve/' for the official curated templates, or 'python'.

name: sandbox_template_list
title: List templates
